title: Thief
note: The specialization every career can follow (D-143): its own XP (thievery), level (1 to 25) and points (one per level above the first). Every skill is consumed by Core code by its id; the effect line is what the detail panel shows.

nodes.title: Casing
nodes.description: Crouch and use a street door with an empty hand to read the place.
nodes.effect: casing also shows the alarm, cameras and who is home

nodes.title: Steady Hands
nodes.description: A calmer hand on the pick: it wobbles less and bends later.
nodes.effect: half the tremor; strain builds a fifth slower

nodes.title: Raking
nodes.description: Scrub a cheap lock open in one quick, noisy try instead of picking it.
nodes.effect: Rake on a latch (70%) or deadbolt (35%); loud

nodes.title: Feel for the Pins
nodes.description: The pick tells the truth, and a spool pin gives itself away.
nodes.effect: exact readings; spool pins are announced

nodes.title: Professional Tools
nodes.description: High-security locks open only to a professional pick set.
nodes.effect: use a Pro Pick Set; open high-security locks

nodes.title: Wire Work
nodes.description: Jam an alarm panel or loop a camera with a Bypass Kit, whatever your trade.
nodes.effect: jam alarm panels and loop cameras with a Bypass Kit

nodes.title: Safecracking
nodes.description: Open a safe by ear. Wall safes in wealthy places open only to a safecracker.
nodes.effect: safes need one pick fewer; wall safes open to you

nodes.title: Soft Steps
nodes.description: Crouched, you are a shadow: people notice you only when you are close.
nodes.effect: crouched, you are seen only within 6 blocks

nodes.title: Quick Hands
nodes.description: Go through a drawer in half the time and without a sound.
nodes.effect: searches take half as long and make no noise

nodes.title: Know Their Routines
nodes.description: Watch long enough and a house tells you when it will be empty.
nodes.effect: casing: when it is next empty, the safe, past break-ins

nodes.title: Camera Sense
nodes.description: See where a camera looks, and feel it a moment before it sees you.
nodes.effect: see camera fields; a warning before one sees you

nodes.title: Clean Getaway
nodes.description: Break the line of sight and keep moving: the police lose you sooner.
nodes.effect: officers give up twice as fast once they lose you

nodes.title: Ghost
nodes.description: Nobody saw a thing. A clean pick slips past all but a certain alarm.
nodes.effect: witnesses a quarter less likely; clean picks slip alarms

nodes.title: Fence Contacts
nodes.description: You know who buys. Carry stolen goods and your side display points the way.
nodes.effect: the side display points to the nearest open fence

nodes.title: Haggler
nodes.description: A fence's first offer is never the last one.

nodes.title: Specialist Buyers
nodes.description: Every fence has goods they want most. They pay you their premium for them.
nodes.effect: a fence's specialty pays +15% of worth
